title: Content Quality Alignment — DL-016 Remediation
primary_finding: DL-016 (ExplanationWrong +1 shift artifact) was active in Pack C Section F and Pack D Section F. Pack A Section F was clean (0 DL-016). Remediated ~57 items with ~99 fields across Packs C and D.

pack_a_section_f.note: Ancillary finding: P1-F-009 has DL-030 (CorrectChoice should be C for Timeliness, not D for Validity). Flagged for future session.

pack_c_section_f.topics: data governance, predictive analytics, RPA, cloud, CIA triad, blockchain, ML, phishing, ERP, data lake, continuous auditing
pack_c_section_f.remaining_dl026: 33 slots (pre-existing from pre-S826 state — needs cross-session verification)

pack_d_section_f.topics: API integration, self-service BI, encryption, SaaS, overfitting, IoT, incident response, digital signatures, MDM, automation governance, NLP, NIST CSF, cost-benefit analysis

classification: DL-016 is a content-correctness issue (not just metadata-labeling). Affected items had ExplanationWrong text describing a different item's choices — learners saw wrong explanations for wrong answers. Scoring unaffected; CorrectChoice and ExplanationCorrect were always aligned.
